analysis_zh.methods: SARI 病因汇总为 SARS-CoV-2、流感、呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 和其他病毒(副流感病毒、腺病毒、鼻病毒、博卡病毒、偏肺病毒)。当缺乏实验室确认时,使用多项回归来估算可能的死亡原因。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者得出的结论是,虽然 SARS-CoV-2 相关的 死亡率 有所下降,但 2025/2 年 5 岁以下儿童和老年人中流感和 RSV 导致的 死亡率 显着增加,凸显了呼吸道病毒负担的变化。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调,公共卫生政策需要优先考虑 疫苗 对抗流感和 RSV 的作用,特别是在幼儿和老年人等高危人群中。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究依赖于汇总的国家 监测 数据,并对未经证实的原因进行插补,这可能会引入错误分类偏差并限制因果推断;由于这些方法学限制,证据强度被评估为中等。

papers.title: Kiến thức, thái độ và dự định tiêm vắc xin phòng vi rút hợp bào hô hấp của khách hàng tại Phòng tiêm chủng Trường Đại học Y Hà Nội năm 2025 Knowledge, attitude and intention to receive the respiratory syncytial virus vaccine among clients attending the Immunization Clinic of Hanoi Medical University in 2025
papers.abstract: Nghiên cứu cắt ngang được thực hiện trên 425 đối tượng từ 18 tuổi trở lên tại phòng tiêm chủng trườngĐại học Y Hà Nội năm 2025, được tiến hành từ tháng 11/2025 đến tháng 5/2026. Mục tiêu nghiên cứunhằm đánh giá kiến thức, thái độ, dự định tiêm vắc xin phòng vi rút hợp bào hô hấp (RSV) và một số yếutố liên quan. Kết quả nghiên cứu cho thấy phần lớn đối tượng nghiên cứu có kiến thức hạn chế về vắc xinphòng RSV (17,9%), trong đó khoảng một phần ba (35,8%) chưa từng nghe về vắc xin này. Tuy nhiên, đasố người tham gia có thái độ tích cực về vắc xin phòng RSV (63,3%). Đáng chú ý, có tới 79,1% đối tượngbày tỏ có dự định tiêm vắc xin phòng RSV với lý do chính là lo ngại về nguy cơ mắc RSV. Kết quả phântích hồi quy logistic đa biến cho thấy những người có kiến thức đạt về vắc xin có liên quan đến dự địnhtiêm cao hơn (OR = 11,35; 95%CI: 1,92 – 67,29). Tương tự, thái độ tích cực về vắc xin cũng liên quan đếndự định tiêm cao hơn (OR = 5,64; 95%CI: 2,71 – 11,74) so với nhóm có thái độ không tích cực. Ngược lại,việc tiếp cận thông tin từ bạn bè có liên quan đến dự định tiêm thấp hơn (OR = 0,29; 95% CI: 0,10 – 0,89)so với nhóm còn lại. Các yếu tố như kiến thức và thái độ tích cực đóng vai trò quan trọng trong việc thúcđẩy ý định tiêm, trong khi các nguồn thông tin không chính thống có thể làm giảm niềm tin vào vắc xin. Dođó, cần tăng cường truyền thông chính thống và tư vấn y tế nhằm nâng cao nhận thức và chuyển hóa ýđịnh thành hành vi tiêm chủng thực tế.
papers.journal: Tạp chí Y học Dự phòng

papers.title_original: Kiến thức, thái độ và dự định tiêm vắc xin phòng vi rút hợp bào hô hấp của khách hàng tại Phòng tiêm chủng Trường Đại học Y Hà Nội năm 2025 Knowledge, attitude and intention to receive the respiratory syncytial virus vaccine among clients attending the Immunization Clinic of Hanoi Medical University in 2025

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addressed the limited public knowledge and awareness of the respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) vaccine among adults in Vietnam, aiming to evaluate knowledge, attitudes, and intention to receive the vaccine. It sought to identify factors influencing vaccine acceptance in a clinical setting.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A cross-sectional study was conducted among 425 adults aged 18 years or older attending the Immunization Clinic of Hanoi Medical University between November 2025 and May 2026. Participants were clients receiving vaccination services at the specified clinic during the study period.
analysis.methods: The study assessed knowledge, attitudes, and intention to receive the RSV vaccine using structured questionnaires. Logistic regression analysis was performed to identify factors associated with the intention to receive the vaccine, including knowledge and attitude scores.
analysis.main_results: Only 17.9% of participants had adequate knowledge about the RSV vaccine, with 35.8% having never heard of it. A majority (63.3%) held positive attitudes toward the vaccine, and 79.1% expressed intention to receive it, primarily due to concerns about RSV infection risk. Multivariable logistic regression showed that adequate knowledge (OR = 11.35; 95% CI: 1.92–67.29) and positive attitudes (OR = 5.64; 95% CI: 2.71–11.74) were strongly associated with higher intention to vaccinate, while information from friends was associated with lower intention (OR = 0.29; 95% CI: 0.10–0.89).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that higher knowledge and positive attitudes significantly increased the likelihood of intending to receive the RSV vaccine, while informal information sources reduced acceptance. They highlighted the need for targeted health communication to improve vaccine uptake.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that improving public knowledge and attitudes through official health communication channels could enhance RSV vaccine acceptance and inform vaccination strategies in similar clinical settings.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study was limited by its single-center, cross-sectional design, which restricts generalizability and causal inference. The reliance on self-reported intention rather than actual vaccination behavior further constrains the strength of evidence, warranting cautious interpretation.

analysis.summary_en: This cross-sectional study evaluated knowledge, attitudes, and intention to receive the respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) vaccine among 425 adults attending an immunization clinic in Hanoi, Vietnam, from November 2025 to May 2026. It found that only 17.9% had adequate knowledge about the vaccine, with 35.8% unaware of its existence, yet 63.3% held positive attitudes and 79.1% intended to receive it, primarily due to infection risk concerns. Multivariable analysis revealed that adequate knowledge (OR = 11.35; 95% CI: 1.92–67.29) and positive attitudes (OR = 5.64; 95% CI: 2.71–11.74) strongly predicted higher vaccination intention, while information from friends reduced intention (OR = 0.29; 95% CI: 0.10–0.89). The authors concluded that targeted health communication and counseling could improve vaccine acceptance. However, the single-center design and reliance on intention rather than actual vaccination limit generalizability and causal inference.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究针对越南成年人对 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 疫苗 的有限公众知识和认识的问题,旨在评估接受 疫苗 的知识、态度和意图。它试图找出影响临床环境中 疫苗 接受度的因素。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 对2025年11月至2026年5月期间在河内医科大学免疫诊所就诊的425名18岁或以上成年人进行了一项横断面研究。参与者是研究期间在指定诊所接受疫苗接种服务的客户。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究使用结构化问卷评估了接收 RSV 疫苗 的知识、态度和意图。进行逻辑回归分析以确定与接受 疫苗 的意图相关的因素,包括知识和态度得分。
elements_zh.main_results: 只有 17.9% 的参与者对 RSV 疫苗 有足够的了解,35.8% 的参与者从未听说过。大多数人(63.3%)对疫苗持积极态度,79.1%表示有意接受,主要是出于对RSV感染风险的担忧。多变量逻辑回归显示,足够的知识(OR = 11.35;95% CI:1.92-67.29)和积极态度(OR = 5.64;95% CI:2.71-11.74)与较高的疫苗接种意愿密切相关,而来自朋友的信息与较低的接种意愿相关(OR = 0.29;95% CI:0.10-0.89)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,更高的知识和积极的态度显着增加了打算接收 RSV 疫苗 的可能性,而非正式信息来源则降低了接受度。他们强调需要进行有针对性的健康沟通,以提高 疫苗 的吸收率。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,通过官方健康沟通渠道提高公众知识和态度可以提高 RSV 疫苗 的接受度,并为类似临床环境中的 疫苗接种 策略提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到单中心、横截面设计的限制,限制了普遍性和因果推理。对自我报告意图而不是实际 疫苗接种 行为的依赖进一步限制了证据的强度,需要谨慎解释。

papers.title: The outpatient economic burden of respiratory syncytial virus infection in adults aged ≥ 60 years in Germany: results from the BUCOSS study
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is a major cause of acute respiratory infection (ARI) in adults aged ≥ 60 years, but data on its outpatient epidemiology and societal costs remain limited. Methods BUCOSS was a prospective observational study conducted over 3 seasons (2022/23–2024/25) in adults aged ≥ 60 years presenting with ARI to 29 outpatient practices in Germany. Multiplex PCR testing was performed at baseline. RSV-positive patients were prospectively followed for up to 28 days. Clinical and socioeconomic burden, including direct medical, indirect, and patient-borne out-of-pocket costs, was assessed using structured questionnaires on days 0, 14, and 28. Approximate national burden was estimated using incidence-based and ARE–prevalence-based extrapolation, including an additional scenario analysis excluding indirect costs. Results Among 3,261 patients with ARI, 192 (5.9%) had PCR-confirmed RSV infection. RSV prevalence was 5.49%, and estimated RSV incidence was 1,030.6 cases per 100,000 population. After exclusion of 4 patients hospitalized at baseline, 188 patients were included in the outpatient cost analysis. Mean age was 71.6 (SD 8.52) years, 57.4% were female, and 60.1% met the study high-risk criteria. Mean societal cost per episode was €510.0 (SD €742.58); costs were highest in patients aged 60–64 years. Total costs comprised direct medical costs of €161.3 (SD €59.57), indirect costs of €331.8 (SD €746.75), and out-of-pocket costs of €16.9 (SD €22.25), corresponding to 31.6%, 65.1%, and 3.3% of total societal costs, respectively. Indirect costs were driven almost entirely by productivity losses. Approximately 40% of cases occurred in adults without study-defined high-risk status. The two extrapolation approaches yielded approximate estimates of 258,000–374,000 medically attended outpatient RSV cases per season among adults aged ≥ 60 years in Germany, corresponding to €131.7–190.9 million in societal costs. In a scenario analysis excluding indirect costs, the estimated burden decreased to €46.0–66.7 million per season. Conclusions RSV is an economically important cause of outpatient ARI in older adults. These findings highlight a substantial outpatient burden beyond inpatient care and support RSV prevention strategies in aging populations.

Multiplex PCR testing was performed at baseline. RSV-positive patients were prospectively followed for up to 28 days. Clinical and socioeconomic burden, including direct medical, indirect, and patient-borne out-of-pocket costs, was assessed using structured questionnaires on days 0, 14, and 28. Approximate national burden was estimated using incidence-based and ARE–prevalence-based extrapolation, including an additional scenario analysis excluding indirect costs. Results Among 3,261 patients with ARI, 192 (5.9%) had PCR-confirmed RSV infection. RSV prevalence was 5.49%, and estimated RSV incidence was 1,030.6 cases per 100,000 population. After exclusion of 4 patients hospitalized at baseline, 188 patients were included in the outpatient cost analysis. Mean age was 71.6 (SD 8.52) years, 57.4% were female, and 60.1% met the study high-risk criteria. Mean societal cost per episode was €510.0 (SD €742.58); costs were highest in patients aged 60–64 years. Total costs comprised direct medical costs of €161.3 (SD €59.57), indirect costs of €331.8 (SD €746.75), and out-of-pocket costs of €16.9 (SD €22.25), corresponding to 31.6%, 65.1%, and 3.3% of total societal costs, respectively. Indirect costs were driven almost entirely by productivity losses. Approximately 40% of cases occurred in adults without study-defined high-risk status. The two extrapolation approaches yielded approximate estimates of 258,000–374,000 medically attended outpatient RSV cases per season among adults aged ≥ 60 years in Germany, corresponding to €131.7–190.9 million in societal costs. In a scenario analysis excluding indirect costs, the estimated burden decreased to €46.0–66.7 million per season. Conclusions RSV is an economically important cause of outpatient ARI in older adults. These findings highlight a substantial outpatient burden beyond inpatient care and support RSV prevention strategies in aging populations.

analysis.research_question_and_background: RSV is a leading cause of acute respiratory infection in adults aged 60 years or older, yet outpatient epidemiology and societal cost data remain sparse, creating a knowledge gap that this study aimed to address.
analysis.study_design_and_population: BUCOSS was a prospective observational study conducted across three consecutive seasons (2022/23–2024/25) in 29 outpatient practices in Germany, enrolling adults aged 60 years or older who presented with acute respiratory infection.
analysis.methods: Multiplex PCR testing was performed at baseline to confirm RSV infection, and RSV-positive patients were followed prospectively for up to 28 days using structured questionnaires administered on days 0, 14, and 28 to capture clinical and socioeconomic burden.
analysis.main_results: Among 3,261 patients with acute respiratory infection, 192 (5.9%) had PCR-confirmed RSV infection; after excluding 4 hospitalized patients, 188 were included in the outpatient cost analysis, with a mean societal cost per episode of €510.0 (SD €742.58), comprising direct medical costs of €161.3, indirect costs of €331.8, and out-of-pocket costs of €16.9.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret these findings as demonstrating that RSV imposes a substantial outpatient economic burden in older adults, with indirect costs driven predominantly by productivity losses and a notable proportion of cases occurring in patients without high-risk status.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results support the prioritization of RSV prevention strategies in aging populations and highlight the economic burden of outpatient RSV beyond inpatient care, informing public health policy and vaccine deployment decisions.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study’s limitations include its observational design, reliance on self-reported productivity losses for indirect cost estimation, and potential underestimation of total burden due to exclusion of hospitalized cases, warranting cautious interpretation of the extrapolated national estimates.

analysis.summary_en: This prospective observational study (BUCOSS) assessed the outpatient economic burden of respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) in adults aged 60 years or older in Germany across three seasons (2022/23–2024/25). Among 3,261 patients with acute respiratory infection, 5.9% had PCR-confirmed RSV, with a mean societal cost per episode of €510.0, primarily driven by indirect productivity losses. Extrapolated national estimates suggest 258,000–374,000 medically attended outpatient RSV cases per season, costing €131.7–190.9 million in societal expenses. The findings underscore RSV as an economically important cause of outpatient illness in older adults and support prevention strategies in aging populations.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: RSV 是 60 岁或以上成年人急性呼吸道感染的主要原因,但门诊 流行病学 和社会成本数据仍然很少,造成了本研究旨在解决的知识差距。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: BUCOSS 是一项在德国 29 个门诊诊所连续三个季度(2022/23-2024/25)进行的前瞻性观察性研究,招募了 60 岁或以上患有急性呼吸道感染的成年人。
elements_zh.methods: 在基线时进行多重 PCR 检测以确认 RSV 感染,并使用在第 0、14 和 28 天进行的结构化调查问卷对 RSV 阳性患者进行长达 28 天的前瞻性随访,以了解临床和社会经济负担。
elements_zh.main_results: 在 3,261 名急性呼吸道感染患者中,192 名(5.9%)经 PCR 确诊为 RSV 感染;排除 4 名住院患者后,门诊费用分析中纳入了 188 名患者,每次发作的平均社会成本为 510.0 欧元(SD 742.58 欧元),其中直接医疗费用为 161.3 欧元,间接费用为 331.8 欧元,自付费用为 16.9 欧元。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为,RSV 给老年人带来了沉重的门诊经济负担,间接成本主要由生产力损失造成,而且很大一部分病例发生在没有高危状态的患者中。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果支持在老龄化人群中优先考虑 RSV 预防策略,并强调门诊 RSV 超出住院护理的经济负担,为公共卫生政策和 疫苗 部署决策提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性包括其观察性设计、依赖自我报告的生产力损失来估计间接成本,以及由于排除住院病例而可能低估总负担,因此需要对推断的国家估计值进行谨慎解释。

papers.title: Evaluation of Universal Biomolecular Medium for Molecular Detection of Respiratory Viruses: A Paired, Multi-Platform Comparison
papers.abstract: Pre-analytical variables, including specimen transport media, may influence the performance of molecular assays used for respiratory pathogen detection. Universal Biomolecular Medium (UBMTM) has been developed to support nucleic acid preservation and molecular testing, but evidence regarding its analytical compatibility with routinely used molecular platforms remains limited. We conducted a retrospective paired comparison of UBMTM against conventional transport and lysis media across multiple molecular platforms to evaluate the post-collection analytical compatibility of UBM. Residual respiratory specimens positive for SARS-CoV-2, influenza A virus, influenza B virus, respiratory syncytial virus, human rhinovirus, human metapneumovirus, Haemophilus influenzae, Mycoplasma pneumoniae, and Bordetella pertussis were analyzed. Paired aliquots generated from the same specimen were tested using the AllplexTM SARS-CoV-2/FluA/FluB/RSV Assay, Xpert® Xpress CoV-2/Flu/RSV plus, Panther Fusion® SARS-CoV-2/Flu A/B/RSV Assay, and selected AllplexTM respiratory panels. Analytical agreement and cycle threshold (Ct) values were compared using paired statistical analyses and Bland–Altman methods. UBM demonstrated complete qualitative concordance with comparator media across all evaluated targets and platforms, yielding 100% positive, negative and overall agreement. Although statistically significant Ct differences were observed for selected target–platform combinations, these shifts were generally small and did not affect qualitative result interpretation. Internal control performance remained stable across media. These findings support the post-collection analytical compatibility of UBMTM with the evaluated molecular workflows.

papers.title: Consensus based expert recommendations for management and prevention of RSV infections in older adults in emerging market countries: results from an expert panel structured survey
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) can cause serious disease in older adults (OAs), particularly those with comorbidities. It is a leading cause of acute respiratory illness and lower respiratory tract infections in adults ≥60 years. Its impact on morbidity, mortality, and healthcare systems is becoming evident. Questions about the burden of disease (BoD) are raised due to underdiagnosis and the similarity with other respiratory illnesses. First opportunities for prevention came in 2023 and 2024, with vaccines approved for ≥60 years, expanding eligibility to additional age groups. RESEARCH DESIGN AND METHODS: A modified Delphi approach through a questionnaire survey and virtual consensus workshop with 27 experts in respiratory and infectious diseases from 12 emerging market countries was done to reach consensus on diagnosis, prevention, and treatment of RSV in OAs. RESULTS: The panel recommends the introduction of a universal vaccination program for all adults aged ≥70 years, and vaccination for all adults aged ≥60 years with comorbidities. The need for increased awareness, better testing, and national and international guidelines was also agreed. CONCLUSION: The agreements highlight that RSV vaccination for OAs should be prioritized. Educating clinicians and patients, improving surveillance, and integrating RSV vaccination into health policies are key to reducing BoD in OAs.

analysis.summary_en: This expert consensus review addresses RSV in older adults, emphasizing its significant burden as a leading cause of acute respiratory illness and lower respiratory tract infections in adults aged ≥60 years. Actionable priorities include clinician and patient education, enhanced surveillance, and policy integration to mitigate RSV impact in this vulnerable population.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 可导致老年人 (OA) 患严重疾病,尤其是患有合并症的老年人。它是 60 岁以上成人急性呼吸道疾病和下呼吸道感染的主要原因。它对发病率、死亡率 和医疗保健系统的影响正变得越来越明显。由于诊断不足以及与其他呼吸道疾病的相似性,人们对疾病负担 (BoD) 提出了疑问。第一次预防机会出现在 2023 年和 2024 年,疫苗 获得批准的年龄≥60 岁,将资格扩大到其他年龄组。研究设计和方法:采用改良的德尔菲法,通过问卷调查和来自 12 个新兴市场国家的 27 名呼吸道和传染病专家参加的虚拟共识研讨会,就 OA 中 RSV 的 诊断、预防和 治疗 达成共识。结果:专家组建议为所有年龄≥70岁的成年人引入通用的疫苗接种计划,并为所有年龄≥60岁有合并症的成年人引入疫苗接种。还同意需要提高认识、更好的测试以及国家和国际指南。结论:协议强调应优先考虑用于 OA 的 RSV 疫苗接种。对临床医生和患者进行教育、改进 监测 并将 RSV 疫苗接种 纳入卫生政策是减少 OA 中 BoD 的关键。

papers.title: Pediatricians’ attitudes and knowledge of RSV immunization products: A multi-country cross-sectional survey
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVE: Nirsevimab and the maternal vaccination in pregnancy are newly introduced prevention strategies against respiratory syncytial virus (RSV). This study evaluated pediatricians' knowledge, attitudes, and barriers to RSV immunization in Italy and Cyprus/Greece, where nirsevimab had not yet been implemented, and in Spain, where it was introduced in 2023/2024. METHODS: A survey was distributed to pediatricians across Spain, Italy, and Cyprus/Greece in July-August/2024. Occupational characteristics, and knowledge, attitudes and practices toward palivizumab, nirsevimab, and the maternal vaccine were collected. Of 578 respondents (response rate = 19.3%), 50% were from Spain, 40% from Italy, and 10% from Cyprus/Greece. As 90% of responses came from Spain and Italy, the main analysis focused on these two countries. Descriptive and univariate analyses (Chi-square or Fisher's exact tests) were conducted. RESULTS: Respondents included pediatricians from community (51.7%), tertiary (30.4%), and primary/secondary care (17.9%) settings. Pediatricians were generally aware of RSV risk factors, without differences across countries. However, 245 (55.9%) and 375 (86.0%) participants reported average-to-low knowledge of nirsevimab and the maternal vaccine, respectively, with differences across countries (p = 0.002). Despite limited knowledge, 311 (85.9%) pediatricians were willing to administer nirsevimab, and 319 (92.2%) supported its use for all infants. Nirsevimab administration's barriers, including unfamiliarity and logistical challenges, were cited by 69 (20.0%) pediatricians. Regarding immunization preferences, 165 (47.4%) pediatricians were very likely to support the maternal vaccine over nirsevimab. CONCLUSIONS: While pediatricians support RSV immunization, knowledge gaps and logistical barriers may hinder early-stage implementation. Optimizing education on RSV immunization will be crucial to improve uptake and prevention strategies.

A survey was distributed to pediatricians across Spain, Italy, and Cyprus/Greece in July-August/2024. Occupational characteristics, and knowledge, attitudes and practices toward palivizumab, nirsevimab, and the maternal vaccine were collected. Of 578 respondents (response rate = 19.3%), 50% were from Spain, 40% from Italy, and 10% from Cyprus/Greece. As 90% of responses came from Spain and Italy, the main analysis focused on these two countries. Descriptive and univariate analyses (Chi-square or Fisher's exact tests) were conducted. Respondents included pediatricians from community (51.7%), tertiary (30.4%), and primary/secondary care (17.9%) settings. Pediatricians were generally aware of RSV risk factors, without differences across countries. However, 245 (55.9%) and 375 (86.0%) participants reported average-to-low knowledge of nirsevimab and the maternal vaccine, respectively, with differences across countries (p = 0.002). Despite limited knowledge, 311 (85.9%) pediatricians were willing to administer nirsevimab, and 319 (92.2%) supported its use for all infants. Nirsevimab administration's barriers, including unfamiliarity and logistical challenges, were cited by 69 (20.0%) pediatricians. Regarding immunization preferences, 165 (47.4%) pediatricians were very likely to support the maternal vaccine over nirsevimab. While pediatricians support RSV immunization, knowledge gaps and logistical barriers may hinder early-stage implementation. Optimizing education on RSV immunization will be crucial to improve uptake and prevention strategies.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)免疫产品如尼塞韦单抗和孕妇疫苗接种等孕期预防策略是新推出的预防策略,但其实施需要了解儿科医生的知识和态度。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2024 年 7 月至 8 月,对西班牙、意大利和塞浦路斯/希腊的儿科医生进行了一项横断面调查,以评估对 RSV 免疫产品的知识、态度和障碍。
elements_zh.methods: 该调查收集了有关帕利珠单抗、尼塞韦单抗 和母亲 疫苗 的职业特征和知识、态度和实践数据,并使用卡方或 Fisher 精确检验进行描述性和单变量分析。
elements_zh.main_results: 在578名受访者中(应答率为19.3%),55.9%报告对尼塞韦单抗的知识水平为中等至较低,86.0%报告对母源尼塞韦单抗的知识水平为中等至较低,且不同国家间存在显著差异(p = 0.002)。尽管知识有限,85.9%的受访者愿意接种尼塞韦单抗,92.2%支持将其用于所有婴儿。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,虽然儿科医生支持 RSV 免疫接种,但知识差距和后勤障碍可能会阻碍早期实施,这凸显了有针对性的教育的必要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,优化 RSV 免疫教育对于改善接种和预防策略至关重要,特别是在新引入 尼塞韦单抗 的环境中。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 低答复率(19.3%)和地域不平衡(90%的答复来自西班牙和意大利)限制了普遍性,而且该研究依赖于自我报告的数据,这可能会引入偏差。

papers.abstract_zh: 目的:尼塞韦单抗和孕期母体疫苗接种是新推出的针对呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)的预防策略。这项研究评估了意大利和塞浦路斯/希腊(尚未实施 尼塞韦单抗)以及西班牙(2023/2024 年引入 尼塞韦单抗)的儿科医生对 RSV 免疫的知识、态度和障碍。方法:2024 年 7 月至 8 月向西班牙、意大利和塞浦路斯/希腊的儿科医生分发了一项调查。收集职业特征以及对帕利珠单抗、尼塞韦单抗 和母亲 疫苗 的知识、态度和实践。在 578 名受访者中(回应率为 19.3%),50% 来自西班牙,40% 来自意大利,10% 来自塞浦路斯/希腊。由于90%的回复来自西班牙和意大利,因此主要分析集中在这两个国家。进行了描述性分析和单变量分析(卡方或费舍尔精确检验)。结果:受访者包括来自社区 (51.7%)、三级 (30.4%) 和初级/二级护理 (17.9%) 机构的儿科医生。儿科医生普遍了解 RSV 危险因素,各国之间没有差异。然而,分别有 245 名 (55.9%) 和 375 名 (86.0%) 参与者报告对 尼塞韦单抗 和母亲 疫苗 的了解处于平均至低水平,不同国家之间存在差异 (p = 0.002)。尽管知识有限,但 311 名 (85.9%) 儿科医生愿意使用 尼塞韦单抗,319 名 (92.2%) 名儿科医生支持对所有婴儿使用该药物。69 名 (20.0%) 儿科医生提到了 尼塞韦单抗 管理的障碍,包括不熟悉和后勤挑战。关于免疫偏好,165 名(47.4%)儿科医生很可能支持孕妇 疫苗 而不是 尼塞韦单抗。结论:虽然儿科医生支持 RSV 免疫接种,但知识差距和后勤障碍可能会阻碍早期实施。优化 RSV 免疫教育对于改善接种和预防策略至关重要。

analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 2024 年 7 月至 8 月,对西班牙、意大利和塞浦路斯/希腊的儿科医生进行了一项横断面调查,以评估对 RSV 免疫产品的知识、态度和障碍。
analysis_zh.methods: 该调查收集了有关帕利珠单抗、尼塞韦单抗 和母亲 疫苗 的职业特征和知识、态度和实践数据,并使用卡方或 Fisher 精确检验进行描述性和单变量分析。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在578名受访者中(应答率为19.3%),55.9%报告对尼塞韦单抗的知识水平为中等至较低,86.0%报告对母源尼塞韦单抗的知识水平为中等至较低,且不同国家间存在显著差异(p = 0.002)。尽管知识有限,85.9%的受访者愿意接种尼塞韦单抗,92.2%支持将其用于所有婴儿。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,虽然儿科医生支持 RSV 免疫接种,但知识差距和后勤障碍可能会阻碍早期实施,这凸显了有针对性的教育的必要性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,优化 RSV 免疫教育对于改善接种和预防策略至关重要,特别是在新引入 尼塞韦单抗 的环境中。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 低答复率(19.3%)和地域不平衡(90%的答复来自西班牙和意大利)限制了普遍性,而且该研究依赖于自我报告的数据,这可能会引入偏差。

papers.title: The economic impact of pediatric RSV-related lower respiratory tract infection in Germany: evidence from the PAPI study
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is a leading cause of acute lower respiratory tract infections (LRTI) in infants and young children. While considerable research has described the clinical burden and direct medical costs of RSV in Germany, the broader economic impact remains poorly understood, particularly the burden on affected families and productivity losses associated with parental work absence. METHODS: The prospective, multicenter PAPI study was conducted across 12 hospitals and five pediatric practices in Germany during the 2021-2022 and 2022-2023 RSV seasons. Children under 24 months presenting with lower respiratory tract infections were tested for RSV. Health care resource use, parental expenses, and absenteeism were assessed through questionnaires and follow-up interviews. The human capital approach was used to estimate productivity losses. RESULTS: Of 1,607 hospitalized children, 918 (57.1%) tested positive for RSV and 714 were included in the analysis. In the outpatient setting, 286 of 1,442 cases (19.8%) were RSV-positive, with 250 included in the analysis. Among hospitalized RSV cases, 91.3% required additional primary care visits. Parental work loss was reported in 64.3% of hospitalized and 37.5% of outpatient cases. Mean productivity losses were €1,865 for hospitalized cases and €1,484 for outpatient cases associated with parental work loss. Productivity losses were higher for toddlers (aged 12-23 months) than infants (0-11 months), with hospitalized toddlers showing the highest mean loss of €2,584 per case involving parental work absence. CONCLUSIONS: This study demonstrates that RSV infections in children under two years impose a substantial economic burden on the German health care system and parents. The findings provide critical evidence to support decision-making on preventive strategies aimed at reducing RSV-related morbidity and its economic consequences in Germany.

Among 1,607 hospitalized children, 57.1% tested RSV-positive, and 19.8% of 1,442 outpatient cases were RSV-positive. Parental work loss occurred in 64.3% of hospitalized and 37.5% of outpatient cases, with mean productivity losses of €1,865 and €1,484 per case, respectively. The study concludes that RSV imposes a substantial economic burden on families and the healthcare system, supporting the need for preventive strategies to mitigate RSV-related morbidity and its economic consequences in Germany.

analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果为支持旨在降低德国 RSV 相关发病率及其经济后果的预防策略决策提供了关键证据。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性在于它只关注单个 RSV 季节,并且依赖于家长报告的缺勤和费用,这可能会引入回忆偏差并低估间接成本,需要对经济负担估计进行谨慎解释。

papers.title: Uptake of the RSVpreF vaccine during pregnancy: associations with socioeconomic status, prenatal care utilization, and maternal risk factors.
papers.abstract: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is a leading cause of infant respiratory illness. In August 2023, the RSV protein-based vaccine (RSVpreF) became the first maternal vaccine approved in the United States to prevent RSV infection in newborns. The study aims to estimate RSVpreF vaccine uptake during its first RSV season and to identify key factors associated with uptake among commercially insured pregnant individuals, using Optum's Clinformatics® Data Mart Database. The study included individuals aged 18-50 with live birth deliveries at or after 32 weeks' gestation between October 1, 2023, and January 31, 2024, continuous enrollment from July 1, 2022, through delivery, and available socioeconomic records. Among 14,121 pregnant individuals,14.5% received the RSVpreF vaccine. Uptake rose from 1.5% among the October 2023 delivery cohort to 28.7% among the January 2024 cohort; 84.6% were vaccinated within the recommended 32-36 week gestational window. In multivariable models, higher uptake was associated with age (30-39 vs 18-29 years: OR = 1.52, 95% CI: 1.28-1.80), household income $60,000-$74,000 (OR = 1.40, 95% CI: 1.05-1.85) or $75,000-$99,000 (OR = 1.47, 95% CI: 1.13-1.92), bachelor's degree or higher (OR = 1.70, 95% CI: 1.48-1.96), PPO insurance (OR = 2.87, 95% CI: 1.70-4.87), prior influenza vaccination (OR = 1.78, 95% CI: 1.56-2.04), receipt of influenza (OR = 3.65, 95% CI: 3.14-4.24) or Tdap (OR = 4.40, 95% CI: 3.53-5.49) vaccines during pregnancy, and each additional week in the RSVpreF vaccination window(OR = 1.27; 95% CI: 1.06-1.53). Receiving ≥5 of 7 non-vaccine prenatal care services was also associated with higher uptake (OR = 1.82, 95% CI: 1.23-2.70). Comorbidities were not associated with uptake. Maternal RSVpreF vaccine uptake was low during its first on-market season, with significant disparities by sociodemographic factors, uptake of other vaccines, and adherence to recommended prenatal care. Efforts to improve equitable access and education are needed for effective maternal immunization programs.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is a leading cause of infant respiratory illness, and in August 2023 the RSV protein-based vaccine (RSVpreF) became the first maternal vaccine approved in the United States to prevent RSV infection in newborns.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study estimated RSVpreF vaccine uptake during its first RSV season and identified factors associated with uptake among commercially insured pregnant individuals using Optum's Clinformatics® Data Mart Database.
analysis.methods: The study included individuals aged 18–50 with live birth deliveries at or after 32 weeks' gestation between October 1, 2023, and January 31, 2024, with continuous enrollment from July 1, 2022, through delivery and available socioeconomic records.
analysis.main_results: Among 14,121 pregnant individuals, 14.5% received the RSVpreF vaccine; uptake rose from 1.5% in the October 2023 delivery cohort to 28.7% in the January 2024 cohort, and 84.6% were vaccinated within the recommended 32–36 week gestational window.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: Higher uptake was associated with older age, higher income, higher education, PPO insurance, prior influenza vaccination, receipt of influenza or Tdap vaccines during pregnancy, additional weeks in the vaccination window, and greater adherence to prenatal care.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings highlight disparities in maternal RSVpreF vaccine uptake by sociodemographic factors, other vaccine behaviors, and prenatal care adherence, indicating targets for equitable immunization program improvement.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on a commercially insured population and administrative claims data, which may not capture all relevant clinical or socioeconomic factors, and by the short post-approval observation window.

analysis.summary_en: This study assessed the uptake of the maternal RSVpreF vaccine during its first U.S. season among 14,121 commercially insured pregnant individuals. Overall uptake was 14.5%, increasing from 1.5% in October 2023 to 28.7% by January 2024, with 84.6% vaccinated within the recommended 32–36 week window. Higher uptake was associated with older maternal age, higher household income and education, PPO insurance, prior influenza vaccination, receipt of influenza or Tdap vaccines during pregnancy, longer gestational time in the vaccination window, and greater adherence to prenatal care. Comorbidities showed no association. The authors conclude that low initial uptake and sociodemographic disparities underscore the need for targeted education and equitable access strategies to optimize maternal immunization programs.

papers.title: The limitations of non-mechanistic methods for characterizing pathogen-pathogen interactions: A simulation study.
papers.abstract: Abstract Pathogen-pathogen interactions occur when infection with one pathogen influences one’s chance of infection or disease due to another. Increasingly, evidence suggests that interactions are a common feature of infectious disease epidemiology. However, due to both the nonlinearities and stochasticity inherent to infectious disease transmission, and the frequency of confounding (e.g., by shared seasonal forcing), simple, purely statistical methods for characterizing interactions may be prone to failure. Here, we perform a simulation study to evaluate several more complex non-mechanistic approaches for inferring causality from time series data: generalized additive models (GAMs), Granger causality, transfer entropy, and convergent cross-mapping (CCM). Specifically, we use a two-pathogen mechanistic transmission model, calibrated to produce dynamics resembling outbreaks of influenza and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), to generate synthetic datasets with a range of values for interaction strength and duration. We then apply each method to all synthetic datasets. We find that Granger causality, transfer entropy, and CCM all fail to consistently infer whether data contain signal of an interaction; in particular, methods tend to incorrectly identify interactions where none are modeled (average sensitivity = 80.6%, 92.1%, 72.1%, respectively; average specificity = 31.0%, 33.3%, 33.1%). Furthermore, we find little to no association between point estimates from each method and true interaction strength. In contrast, GAMs infer the existence of interactions more accurately than the other methods (sensitivity = 85.2%, specificity = 72.5%), and consistently yield larger point estimates for stronger interactions. However, their practical utility is limited by an inability to evaluate interaction asymmetry (i.e., whether the effect of pathogen A on pathogen B is identical to that of B on A). Overall performance patterns were similar when methods were applied to two real-world datasets from Hong Kong and Canada. We conclude that accurately and comprehensively characterizing pathogen-pathogen interactions based on outbreak data remains a significant challenge. For this reason, it is critical that any proposed methods be rigorously evaluated before being used to draw conclusions about interactions. Author Summary Pathogen-pathogen interactions occur when infection with one pathogen either increases or decreases a person’s risk of infection or illness due to a second, distinct pathogen. Because interactions affect several common human pathogens, including influenza and SARS-CoV-2, a better understanding of interactions could improve epidemic control. However, past work has shown that simple methods commonly used to study interactions can lead to inaccurate conclusions. Here, we tested four methods frequently used in other fields, including ecology and neuroscience, to see whether they may also be useful for identifying interactions. Specifically, we tested each method using simulated outbreak data generated from a mathematical model. We found that most methods struggled to correctly determine whether an interaction effect was present; in particular, methods often falsely identified interactions when none occurred. Although one of the tested methods, generalized additive models, performed comparatively well at identifying interactions, it provided relatively little additional information about the interactions. Because pathogen-pathogen interactions are so challenging to study, it is important that researchers rigorously test methods before applying them to interactions, so as not to publish potentially misleading results. More broadly, a complete understanding of interactions will likely require a variety of approaches, including both laboratory and modeling studies.

papers.title_zh: 表征病原体-病原体相互作用的非机械方法的局限性:模拟研究。
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Pathogen-pathogen interactions occur when infection with one pathogen influences one’s chance of infection or disease due to another. Increasingly, evidence suggests that interactions are a common feature of infectious disease epidemiology. However, due to both the nonlinearities and stochasticity inherent to infectious disease transmission, and the frequency of confounding (e.g., by shared seasonal forcing), simple, purely statistical methods for characterizing interactions may be prone to failure. Here, we perform a simulation study to evaluate several more complex non-mechanistic approaches for inferring causality from time series data: generalized additive models (GAMs), Granger causality, transfer entropy, and convergent cross-mapping (CCM). Specifically, we use a two-pathogen mechanistic transmission model, calibrated to produce dynamics resembling outbreaks of influenza and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), to generate synthetic datasets with a range of values for interaction strength and duration. We then apply each method to all synthetic datasets. We find that Granger causality, transfer entropy, and CCM all fail to consistently infer whether data contain signal of an interaction; in particular, methods tend to incorrectly identify interactions where none are modeled (average sensitivity = 80.6%, 92.1%, 72.1%, respectively; average specificity = 31.0%, 33.3%, 33.1%). Furthermore, we find little to no association between point estimates from each method and true interaction strength. In contrast, GAMs infer the existence of interactions more accurately than the other methods (sensitivity = 85.2%, specificity = 72.5%), and consistently yield larger point estimates for stronger interactions. However, their practical utility is limited by an inability to evaluate interaction asymmetry (i.e., whether the effect of pathogen A on pathogen B is identical to that of B on A). Overall performance patterns were similar when methods were applied to two real-world datasets from Hong Kong and Canada. We conclude that accurately and comprehensively characterizing pathogen-pathogen interactions based on outbreak data remains a significant challenge. For this reason, it is critical that any proposed methods be rigorously evaluated before being used to draw conclusions about interactions. Author Summary Pathogen-pathogen interactions occur when infection with one pathogen either increases or decreases a person’s risk of infection or illness due to a second, distinct pathogen. Because interactions affect several common human pathogens, including influenza and SARS-CoV-2, a better understanding of interactions could improve epidemic control. However, past work has shown that simple methods commonly used to study interactions can lead to inaccurate conclusions. Here, we tested four methods frequently used in other fields, including ecology and neuroscience, to see whether they may also be useful for identifying interactions. Specifically, we tested each method using simulated outbreak data generated from a mathematical model. We found that most methods struggled to correctly determine whether an interaction effect was present; in particular, methods often falsely identified interactions when none occurred. Although one of the tested methods, generalized additive models, performed comparatively well at identifying interactions, it provided relatively little additional information about the interactions. Because pathogen-pathogen interactions are so challenging to study, it is important that researchers rigorously test methods before applying them to interactions, so as not to publish potentially misleading results. More broadly, a complete understanding of interactions will likely require a variety of approaches, including both laboratory and modeling studies.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要:当一种病原体的感染影响另一种病原体感染或患病的机会时,就会发生病原体与病原体之间的相互作用。越来越多的证据表明,相互作用是传染病 流行病学 的一个共同特征。然而,由于传染病 传播 固有的非线性和随机性,以及混杂的频率(例如,通过共享季节性强迫),用于表征相互作用的简单、纯统计方法可能容易失败。在这里,我们进行了一项模拟研究,以评估从时间序列数据推断因果关系的几种更复杂的非机械方法:广义加性模型(GAM)、格兰杰因果关系、传递熵和收敛交叉映射(CCM)。具体来说,我们使用双病原体机制 传播 模型,经过校准以产生类似于流感 暴发 和 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 的动力学,以生成具有一系列相互作用强度和持续时间值的合成数据集。然后,我们将每种方法应用于所有合成数据集。我们发现格兰杰因果关系、转移熵和 CCM 都无法一致地推断数据是否包含交互信号;特别是,方法往往会错误地识别未建模的相互作用(平均灵敏度分别为 80.6%、92.1%、72.1%;平均特异性 = 31.0%、33.3%、33.1%)。此外,我们发现每种方法的点估计与真实的相互作用强度之间几乎没有关联。相比之下,GAM 比其他方法更准确地推断相互作用的存在(灵敏度 = 85.2%,特异性 = 72.5%),并且对于更强的相互作用始终产生更大的点估计。然而,它们的实际用途受到无法评估相互作用不对称性的限制(即病原体 A 对病原体 B 的影响是否与 B 对 A 的影响相同)。当将方法应用于来自香港和加拿大的两个现实世界数据集时,总体性能模式相似。我们的结论是,基于 暴发 数据准确、全面地描述病原体与病原体之间的相互作用仍然是一个重大挑战。因此,在用于得出有关相互作用的结论之前,必须对任何提出的方法进行严格评估,这一点至关重要。作者总结 当一种病原体的感染增加或降低一个人因另一种不同的病原体而感染或患病的风险时,就会发生病原体与病原体之间的相互作用。由于相互作用会影响几种常见的人类病原体,包括流感和 SARS-CoV-2,因此更好地了解相互作用可以改善流行病控制。然而,过去的工作表明,通常用于研究相互作用的简单方法可能会导致不准确的结论。在这里,我们测试了生态学和神经科学等其他领域常用的四种方法,看看它们是否也可用于识别相互作用。具体来说,我们使用数学模型生成的模拟 暴发 数据测试了每种方法。我们发现大多数方法都难以正确确定是否存在交互效应;特别是,当没有发生相互作用时,方法经常错误地识别相互作用。尽管其中一种测试方法(广义加性模型)在识别相互作用方面表现相对较好,但它提供的有关相互作用的附加信息相对较少。由于病原体与病原体之间的相互作用的研究非常具有挑战性,因此研究人员在将方法应用于相互作用之前必须严格测试方法,以免发表潜在的误导性结果。更广泛地说,对相互作用的完整理解可能需要多种方法,包括实验室和建模研究。

papers.title: Evaluating the Uptake, Safety and Effectiveness of the Maternal RSV Vaccine (RSVpreF) Against Infant Bronchiolitis: Preliminary Real-World Evidence
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is a leading cause of infant hospitalization globally. On September 1, 2024, England introduced the bivalent RSVpreF vaccine for maternal immunization following trial evidence of safety and efficacy. However, real-world data on uptake, safety and effectiveness remain limited. METHODS: We conducted a retrospective audit using routinely collected electronic health record data from Oxford University Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust. All live births between September 1 and October 31, 2024, were included. Maternal RSV vaccination status, demographic factors and perinatal outcomes were analyzed. RSV-related hospitalizations were tracked from November 1, 2024, to March 12, 2025. Vaccine effectiveness (VE) was calculated as 1 - (risk in vaccinated/risk in unvaccinated) × 100. RESULTS: Among 1057 live births, 341 mothers (32.3%) received RSVpreF vaccination during pregnancy. Uptake was higher in older and primiparous mothers and strongly associated with receipt of pertussis vaccine (41.3% vs. 11.6%; P 14 days post-vaccination and in 36 of 772 unvaccinated infants, yielding a crude VE of 78.3% (95% confidence interval, 9.1-94.8) in infants <6 months of age. VE against bronchiolitis-coded admissions was 56.4% (95% confidence interval, 13.1-78.2). CONCLUSIONS: Maternal RSV vaccination was associated with substantial protection against infant RSV hospitalization during the first UK season of implementation. Uptake improved over time but remained relatively low. Early safety data are reassuring. Continued surveillance and larger multisite evaluations are needed to support national program monitoring and integration.

papers.title: Trends and outcomes of Mycoplasma pneumoniae pneumonia in hospitalized children before, during, and after the coronavirus disease 2019 pandemic: a retrospective study in Northeast China, 2018-2023.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Mycoplasma pneumoniae pneumonia (MPP) is the most common form of community-acquired pneumonia, which shows an epidemic interval of 3–7 years. This study was conducted to understand the changing trends in MPP in children hospitalized before and during the coronavirus disease 2019 pandemic and determine adverse outcomes and their influencing factors. This was a retrospective cohort study of children aged 28 days to 14 years hospitalized for MPP at our institution between January 2018 and December 2023. Clinical characteristics, adverse outcomes, and associated factors were analyzed using the chi-square test and multivariable logistic regression. A P < 0.05 was considered statistically significant. A total of 17,505 MPP cases were included, with the highest case number (4,619) in 2023. In 2023, the proportion of severe pneumonia was 44.1%, and bronchoscopy usage was 33.5%, both significantly higher than in 2018–2022. Older age, admission during July–December, co-infection with Epstein-Barr virus, chlamydia, or other bacteria, and complications, including pleural effusion, abnormal liver enzymes, acute respiratory distress syndrome, or atelectasis, were associated with bronchoscopy. Older age, admission during October–December, co-infection with respiratory syncytial virus, adenovirus, Epstein-Barr virus, chlamydia, or other bacteria, and complications, including cardiac failure, abnormal liver enzymes, myocardial damage, or anemia, were associated with severe pneumonia. Cases of MPP, severe pneumonia, and those requiring bronchoscopy increased in 2023 compared with the five previous years. Children with MPP were more susceptible to adverse clinical outcomes, which were associated with age, month of admission, co-infection, and complications. IMPORTANCE Mycoplasma pneumoniae pneumonia (MPP) is a leading cause of community-acquired pneumonia in children. This study analyzed 17,505 hospitalized children in Northeast China from 2018 to 2023 to explore MPP trends before, during, and after the coronavirus disease 2019 pandemic. We found a sharp resurgence of MPP in 2023 with higher rates of severe pneumonia, complications, and bronchoscopy use. Key risk factors for adverse outcomes included older age, admission in October–December, viral/bacterial co-infection, and pulmonary or extrapulmonary complications. These findings improve understanding of post-pandemic MPP epidemiology, support early risk stratification, and help optimize clinical management and public health interventions for childhood MPP.

This study was conducted to understand the changing trends in MPP in children hospitalized before and during the coronavirus disease 2019 pandemic and determine adverse outcomes and their influencing factors. This was a retrospective cohort study of children aged 28 days to 14 years hospitalized for MPP at our institution between January 2018 and December 2023. Clinical characteristics, adverse outcomes, and associated factors were analyzed using the chi-square test and multivariable logistic regression. A P < 0.05 was considered statistically significant. A total of 17,505 MPP cases were included, with the highest case number (4,619) in 2023. In 2023, the proportion of severe pneumonia was 44.1%, and bronchoscopy usage was 33.5%, both significantly higher than in 2018–2022. Older age, admission during July–December, co-infection with Epstein-Barr virus, chlamydia, or other bacteria, and complications, including pleural effusion, abnormal liver enzymes, acute respiratory distress syndrome, or atelectasis, were associated with bronchoscopy. Older age, admission during October–December, co-infection with respiratory syncytial virus, adenovirus, Epstein-Barr virus, chlamydia, or other bacteria, and complications, including cardiac failure, abnormal liver enzymes, myocardial damage, or anemia, were associated with severe pneumonia. Cases of MPP, severe pneumonia, and those requiring bronchoscopy increased in 2023 compared with the five previous years. Children with MPP were more susceptible to adverse clinical outcomes, which were associated with age, month of admission, co-infection, and complications. IMPORTANCE Mycoplasma pneumoniae pneumonia (MPP) is a leading cause of community-acquired pneumonia in children. This study analyzed 17,505 hospitalized children in Northeast China from 2018 to 2023 to explore MPP trends before, during, and after the coronavirus disease 2019 pandemic. We found a sharp resurgence of MPP in 2023 with higher rates of severe pneumonia, complications, and bronchoscopy use. Key risk factors for adverse outcomes included older age, admission in October–December, viral/bacterial co-infection, and pulmonary or extrapulmonary complications. These findings improve understanding of post-pandemic MPP epidemiology, support early risk stratification, and help optimize clinical management and public health interventions for childhood MPP.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究是一项 队列研究 回顾性研究,对象为 2018 年 1 月至 2023 年 12 月期间在该机构因 MPP 住院的 28 天至 14 岁儿童。分析了 2018 年至 2023 年中国东北地区的 17,505 名住院儿童,以探讨 2019 年冠状病毒病大流行之前、期间和之后的 MPP 趋势。
elements_zh.methods: 使用卡方检验和多变量逻辑回归分析临床特征、不良结果和相关因素。
elements_zh.main_results: 与前五年相比,2023 年 MPP、重症肺炎和需要支气管镜检查的病例有所增加。2023年,重症肺炎比例为44.1%,支气管镜使用率为33.5%,均显着高于2018-2022年。年龄较大、7月至12月入院、合并EB病毒、衣原体或其他细菌感染以及并发症,包括胸腔积液、肝酶异常、急性呼吸窘迫综合征或肺不张,均与支气管镜检查有关。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为,MPP 将于 2023 年急剧复苏,严重肺炎、并发症和支气管镜使用率更高,这凸显了早期风险分层和优化临床管理的必要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现提高了对大流行后 MPP 流行病学 的理解,支持早期风险分层,并有助于优化儿童 MPP 的临床管理和公共卫生干预措施。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其回顾性设计和数据收集中的潜在偏差而受到限制,但由于样本量大和统计分析,证据是强有力的。

papers.title: Low Cord Blood Titers Are Associated with Prolonged Maternal RSV Antibody Half-Lives in Preterm Infants
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Preterm infants are at higher risk of severe RSV infection, partially because of reduced placental transfer of maternal antibodies (Abs). Increased risk of severe infection persists in the first year of life. This study evaluates the postnatal kinetics of RSV neutralizing antibodies in preterm and full-term infants born to unvaccinated mothers. Methods We enrolled infants with a gestational age (GA) of 24-42 weeks born in hospital from RSV-unvaccinated mothers. Serum was collected at birth (cord blood), 1–2 weeks, and 4–8 weeks. Linear mixed-effects models were used to estimate half-lives of RSV-neutralizing Abs in relation to GA and cord blood titer. Analyses were repeated for total serum IgG1 to confirm the robustness of our findings. Results Of 169 infants, 95 were born preterm (<37 weeks GA, including 53 neonates <32 weeks GA). Premature birth was related to prolonged half-life of RSV-neutralizing Abs (∼79 days very preterm to ∼30 days in term infants). The inverse association between gestational age and antibody half-life was largely accounted for by an inverse association between cord blood Ab levels and Ab half-life. A doubling in cord blood titers led to a reduction in half-life of ∼20% for RSV neutralizing Abs and ∼32% for IgG1. Conclusions Postnatal antibody half-life depends on starting levels: higher titers decline faster. If our observation would be replicated for vaccine-induced Abs, the difference in vaccine protection between preterm and term infants may be smaller than anticipated.

analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors concluded that postnatal antibody half-life depends on starting levels: higher titers decline faster. analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings may inform the development of more effective vaccination strategies for preterm infants, as they highlight the relationship between initial antibody levels and their postnatal decline, which could impact the timing and efficacy of immunization.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the postnatal kinetics of RSV neutralizing antibodies in preterm and full-term infants born to unvaccinated mothers. It finds that preterm infants have prolonged antibody half-lives compared to term infants, with higher cord blood titers associated with faster decline. The results suggest that vaccine protection may differ less between preterm and term infants than expected. The study uses linear mixed-effects models and confirms findings with IgG1 analyses. While the evidence is robust, the study is limited to unvaccinated mothers and may not apply universally. These findings could inform improved vaccination strategies for preterm infants.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 由于母体抗体胎盘转移减少,早产儿发生严重 RSV 感染的风险较高。本研究旨在评估未接种疫苗的母亲所生早产儿和足月儿 RSV 中和抗体的产后动力学。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究纳入了未接种 RSV 疫苗的母亲在医院出生的胎龄 (GA) 为 24-42 周的婴儿。在 169 名婴儿中,95 名早产(<37 周 GA,其中 53 名新生儿<32 周 GA)。
elements_zh.methods: 在出生时(脐带血)、1-2 周和 4-8 周收集血清。使用线性混合效应模型来估计与 GA 和脐带血滴度相关的 RSV 中和抗体的半衰期。对总血清 IgG1 进行了重复分析,以证实我们研究结果的稳健性。
elements_zh.main_results: 早产与 RSV 中和抗体半衰期延长有关(极早产儿约 79 天,足月儿约 30 天)。胎龄与抗体半衰期之间的负相关很大程度上是由脐带血抗体水平与抗体半衰期之间的负相关引起的。脐带血滴度加倍导致 RSV 中和抗体半衰期缩短约 20%,IgG1 半衰期缩短约 32%。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者得出的结论是,出生后抗体半衰期取决于起始水平:滴度越高,下降速度越快。这一发现表明,如果对 疫苗 诱导的抗体重复我们的观察结果,早产儿和足月儿之间 疫苗 保护的差异可能小于预期。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能为针对早产儿制定更有效的 疫苗接种 策略提供信息,因为它们强调了初始抗体水平与其产后下降之间的关系,这可能会影响免疫接种的时机和效果。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于未接种 RSV 的母亲所生的婴儿,结果可能无法推广到所有人群。证据是强有力的,因为它基于线性混合效应模型和 IgG1 的重复分析。

analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于未接种 RSV 的母亲所生的婴儿,结果可能无法推广到所有人群。证据是强有力的,因为它基于线性混合效应模型和 IgG1 的重复分析。

papers.title: Misdiagnosis of bronchiolitis and misuse of antibiotics - experience from the largest paediatric hospital of Bangladesh.
papers.abstract: Background Bronchiolitis remains the commonest acute lower respiratory tract infection in younger children globally. Bronchiolitis is often misdiagnosed as World Health Organization (WHO)-classified pneumonia due to closely related clinical manifestations. Our primary objective was to assess the prevalence of viral bronchiolitis among WHO-classified pneumonia, and the secondary objective was to evaluate their management. Methods This was a prospective observational study. Infants (aged Results PCR of NPA of 60 WHO-classified pneumonia cases yielded RSV in 41 (68%) who had pertinent clinical symptoms and signs suggestive of bronchiolitis, attested by benign chest radiography (85%). Further, their mean (x̄) and standard deviation (SD) complete blood count (x̄ = 15,488; SD = 1874/cm) with x̄ = 36% (SD = 11) neutrophil) and C-reactive protein (x̄ = 4.49 (5.88) mg/L cut off reference value >5 mg/L) were indicative more as non-bacterial infections favouring RSV bronchiolitis. In contrast, all 19 non-RSV cases did not differ in clinical findings, as attested by haematological, microbiological and radiographical features, suggesting bronchiolitis-like illness, further supported by disease outcome, discharge pattern and LOS (x̄ = 4.7; SD = 2.29) days). Nevertheless, antibiotics were given in 95% of all 60 cases. Conclusions There was a high proportion of bronchiolitis among WHO-classified pneumonia, and antimicrobials were prescribed to treat those cases. The findings need the attention of policymakers to address the overlap between WHO-classified pneumonia and bronchiolitis and minimise the potential overuse of antibiotics.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Bronchiolitis is frequently misdiagnosed as WHO-classified pneumonia due to overlapping clinical features, leading to unnecessary antibiotic use. The study aimed to quantify the prevalence of respiratory syncytial virus (RSV)-associated bronchiolitis among infants classified with pneumonia and to evaluate their clinical management.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This was a prospective observational study conducted in a paediatric hospital in Bangladesh. It included 60 infants aged under 2 years who were classified with WHO-defined pneumonia. Nasopharyngeal aspirates were collected for RSV testing.
analysis.methods: The study used PCR testing of nasopharyngeal aspirates to detect RSV. Clinical management data were collected, including antibiotic prescription practices. Haematological parameters and chest radiography were assessed to differentiate bronchiolitis from pneumonia.
analysis.main_results: PCR testing identified RSV in 41 of 60 cases (68%), all of whom had clinical features consistent with bronchiolitis and benign chest radiographs (85%). Non-RSV cases (19/60) showed similar clinical and radiographic features, suggesting bronchiolitis-like illness. Antibiotics were prescribed in 95% of all 60 cases despite RSV positivity.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The high proportion of RSV-associated bronchiolitis among WHO-classified pneumonia cases highlights diagnostic challenges and contributes to antibiotic overuse. The study underscores the need for improved differentiation between bronchiolitis and pneumonia to guide appropriate treatment.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings support targeted surveillance for RSV in infants with pneumonia-like symptoms to reduce unnecessary antibiotic prescriptions. This could inform national guidelines on respiratory infection management in resource-limited settings.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its single-centre design and small sample size, which may affect generalisability. The lack of a control group and reliance on observational data reduce the strength of causal inferences about antibiotic overuse.

analysis.summary_en: This prospective observational study from a large paediatric hospital in Bangladesh assessed the prevalence of respiratory syncytial virus (RSV)-associated bronchiolitis among 60 infants classified with WHO-defined pneumonia. PCR testing of nasopharyngeal aspirates detected RSV in 68% of cases, with clinical and radiographic features consistent with bronchiolitis. Despite this, antibiotics were prescribed in 95% of cases, indicating significant diagnostic misclassification and antimicrobial misuse. The study highlights the overlap between bronchiolitis and pneumonia and calls for improved diagnostic strategies to reduce unnecessary antibiotic use.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 由于临床特征重叠,毛细支气管炎 经常被误诊为 WHO 分类的肺炎,导致不必要的抗生素使用。该研究旨在量化肺炎婴儿中 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 相关 毛细支气管炎 的 患病率 并评估其临床管理。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这是在孟加拉国一家儿科医院进行的一项前瞻性观察研究。其中包括 60 名 2 岁以下婴儿,他们被归类为世界卫生组织定义的肺炎。收集鼻咽抽吸物用于 RSV 检测。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究使用鼻咽抽吸物的 PCR 检测来检测 RSV。收集临床管理数据,包括抗生素处方实践。评估血液学参数和胸片以区分 毛细支气管炎 和肺炎。
elements_zh.main_results: PCR 检测在 60 例病例中发现了 41 例 (68%) 存在 RSV,所有病例的临床特征均符合 毛细支气管炎 和良性胸部 X 光片 (85%)。非 RSV 病例 (19/60) 显示出相似的临床和影像学特征,提示 毛细支气管炎 样疾病。尽管 RSV 呈阳性,但在所有 60 例病例中,95% 的患者都服用了抗生素。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: WHO 分类的肺炎病例中 RSV 相关 毛细支气管炎 的比例很高,凸显了诊断挑战,并导致抗生素过度使用。该研究强调需要改进 毛细支气管炎 和肺炎之间的区分,以指导适当的 治疗。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果支持针对有肺炎样症状的婴儿进行 RSV 针对性 监测 治疗,以减少不必要的抗生素处方。这可以为资源有限环境中呼吸道感染管理的国家指南提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其单中心设计和小样本量而受到限制,这可能会影响普遍性。缺乏对照组和对观察数据的依赖降低了关于抗生素过度使用的因果推论的强度。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 由于临床特征重叠,毛细支气管炎 经常被误诊为 WHO 分类的肺炎,导致不必要的抗生素使用。该研究旨在量化肺炎婴儿中 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 相关 毛细支气管炎 的 患病率 并评估其临床管理。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 这是在孟加拉国一家儿科医院进行的一项前瞻性观察研究。其中包括 60 名 2 岁以下婴儿,他们被归类为世界卫生组织定义的肺炎。收集鼻咽抽吸物用于 RSV 检测。
analysis_zh.methods: 该研究使用鼻咽抽吸物的 PCR 检测来检测 RSV。收集临床管理数据,包括抗生素处方实践。评估血液学参数和胸片以区分 毛细支气管炎 和肺炎。
analysis_zh.main_results: PCR 检测在 60 例病例中发现了 41 例 (68%) 存在 RSV,所有病例的临床特征均符合 毛细支气管炎 和良性胸部 X 光片 (85%)。非 RSV 病例 (19/60) 显示出相似的临床和影像学特征,提示 毛细支气管炎 样疾病。尽管 RSV 呈阳性,但在所有 60 例病例中,95% 的患者都服用了抗生素。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: WHO 分类的肺炎病例中 RSV 相关 毛细支气管炎 的比例很高,凸显了诊断挑战,并导致抗生素过度使用。该研究强调需要改进 毛细支气管炎 和肺炎之间的区分,以指导适当的 治疗。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果支持针对有肺炎样症状的婴儿进行 RSV 针对性 监测 治疗,以减少不必要的抗生素处方。这可以为资源有限环境中呼吸道感染管理的国家指南提供信息。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其单中心设计和小样本量而受到限制,这可能会影响普遍性。缺乏对照组和对观察数据的依赖降低了关于抗生素过度使用的因果推论的强度。

papers.title: The Epidemiological and Economic Burden of Vaccine-Preventable Respiratory Diseases Among Adults Aged 65 Years and Older in the Nordic Countries
papers.abstract: Background: Despite the increasing availability of tailored vaccines, vaccine-preventable respiratory diseases (VPRDs), including influenza, respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), COVID-19, and pneumococcal disease (PD), continue to impose a significant health and economic burden. This study assessed the epidemiological and economic burden of VPRD among adults aged ≥65 across four Nordic countries (Denmark, Sweden, Norway, and Finland). Methods: Data on incidence, hospital admissions, and mortality were obtained from national statistics (week 21, 2024–week 20, 2025) and supplemented with peer-reviewed literature. A static model was developed to quantify epidemiological and economic burden associated with VPRD during the 2024/2025 winter season. Results: During the 2024/2025 season, VPRD resulted in approximately 830,000 symptomatic cases, 60,300 hospital admissions, and 7750 deaths across the Nordic countries. COVID-19 showed the highest estimated incidence and numbers of hospital admissions, followed by influenza, PD, and RSV. Mortality was comparable between COVID-19 and influenza, followed by PD and RSV. Annual healthcare costs were approximately €1132 million, with productivity losses constituting an additional 7%. Conclusions: Despite national vaccination efforts, VPRDs remain a major health and economic burden in the Nordic countries. Strengthening immunization programs through improved vaccine uptake, broader coverage, and use of advanced vaccines may contribute to further reducing this burden.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addressed the ongoing public-health and economic burden imposed by vaccine-preventable respiratory diseases (VPRDs) in older adults despite available vaccines, explicitly including respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) among the targets.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A static model quantified the epidemiological and economic burden of VPRDs during the 2024/2025 winter season across four Nordic countries (Denmark, Sweden, Norway, and Finland) among adults aged 65 years and older.
analysis.methods: National statistics on incidence, hospital admissions, and mortality from week 21, 2024 to week 20, 2025 were combined with peer-reviewed literature to build a static model estimating burden.
analysis.main_results: In the 2024/2025 season, RSV accounted for approximately 105,000 symptomatic cases, 7,500 hospital admissions, and 970 deaths across the Nordic countries.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the continued high burden of RSV alongside other VPRDs as evidence that current immunization efforts remain insufficient, highlighting RSV as a priority for expanded vaccine strategies.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings support strengthening adult immunization programs through higher vaccine uptake, broader coverage, and adoption of advanced RSV vaccines to reduce hospitalizations and deaths.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The static model relied on national statistics and literature, which may underestimate true burden due to underreporting and limited RSV-specific data, warranting a moderate confidence assessment.

analysis.summary_en: This study quantified the 2024/2025 burden of vaccine-preventable respiratory diseases among adults aged 65 and older in four Nordic countries using a static model that integrated national statistics and literature. RSV contributed approximately 105,000 symptomatic cases, 7,500 hospital admissions, and 970 deaths. Despite national vaccination efforts, the authors concluded that RSV and other VPRDs remain major health and economic burdens, emphasizing the need for improved vaccine uptake, broader coverage, and advanced vaccines. The static model and reliance on aggregated data limit precision, supporting a moderate confidence assessment.

papers.abstract: INTRODUCTION: RNA viruses impose a disproportionate burden of emerging and reemerging infectious diseases in Latin America, yet antiviral discovery in the region remains fragmented, target-limited, and frequently disconnected from translational pathways. This perspective discusses the Red Mexicana de Desarrollo de Antivirales (RMDA) as a network-driven model to organize antiviral discovery against clinically relevant RNA viruses. AREAS COVERED: The authors describe the conceptual architecture of RMDA, a multi-institutional Mexican initiative that integrates computational prioritization, cell-based antiviral evaluation under BSL-2/BSL-3 conditions, mechanistic virology, assessment of pharmacological synergy, in vivo validation, and clinical linkage through healthcare systems such as the Instituto Mexicano del Seguro Social. The framework is supported by prior work from participating groups on host-directed and virus-directed candidates, including metabolic modulators, lipid-lowering agents, nuclear transport inhibitors, natural products, polyphenols, melatonin, and rational drug combinations evaluated against dengue virus, Zika virus, SARS-CoV-2, respiratory syncytial virus, and related RNA viruses. EXPERT OPINION: RMDA provides a scalable and regionally adaptable model for antiviral drug discovery in low- and middle-income settings. By aligning distributed expertise, standardized workflows, and translational decision points, this framework may accelerate candidate prioritization, reduce duplication, and strengthen preparedness against RNA virus threats in Mexico and Latin America.

papers.abstract_zh: 简介:RNA 病毒对拉丁美洲新出现和重新出现的传染病造成了不成比例的负担,但该地区的 抗病毒药物 发现仍然支离破碎、目标有限,并且经常与转化途径脱节。本视角讨论了 Red Mexicana de Desarrollo de 抗病毒药物 (RMDA) 作为网络驱动模型来组织针对临床相关 RNA 病毒的 抗病毒药物 发现。涵盖领域:作者描述了 RMDA 的概念架构,这是一项墨西哥多机构倡议,整合了计算优先级、BSL-2/BSL-3 条件下基于细胞的 抗病毒药物 评估、机械病毒学、药理学协同评估、体内验证以及通过医疗保健系统(例如 Instituto Mexicano del Seguro Social)的临床联系。该框架得到了参与小组先前关于 宿主 导向和病毒导向候选药物的工作的支持,包括代谢调节剂、降脂剂、核转运抑制剂、天然产物、多酚、褪黑激素以及针对登革热病毒、寨卡病毒、SARS-CoV-2、呼吸道合胞病毒 和相关 RNA 病毒进行评估的合理药物组合。专家意见:RMDA 为中低收入环境中的 抗病毒药物 药物发现提供了一个可扩展且区域适应性强的模型。通过协调分布式专业知识、标准化工作流程和转化决策点,该框架可以加速候选者的优先级排序、减少重复并加强墨西哥和拉丁美洲针对 RNA 病毒威胁的准备。

papers.title: Epitranscriptomic regulation of host-virus interactions.
papers.abstract: RNA chemical modifications, collectively termed the epitranscriptome, are now recognized as critical regulators of gene expression that influence host antiviral responses. These modifications are frequently co-opted by both RNA and DNA viruses to enhance their replication and evade immune detection. This review explores key RNA modifications, principal modifying enzymes, emphasizing how these modifications regulate mRNA stability, translation, and innate immune recognition of both host and viral RNAs. Furthermore, this review examines how viruses, including DENV, SARS-CoV-2, HIV-1, HCV, RSV, and HSV, manipulate host RNA modification systems. Overall, this review highlights the epitranscriptome as a dynamic interface in host-virus interactions and underscores its potential as a target for antiviral therapeutic development.
papers.journal: Biochimica et biophysica acta. Molecular basis of disease

papers.title_zh: 宿主-病毒相互作用的表观转录组调控。
papers.source_body_en: RNA chemical modifications, collectively termed the epitranscriptome, are now recognized as critical regulators of gene expression that influence host antiviral responses. These modifications are frequently co-opted by both RNA and DNA viruses to enhance their replication and evade immune detection. This review explores key RNA modifications, principal modifying enzymes, emphasizing how these modifications regulate mRNA stability, translation, and innate immune recognition of both host and viral RNAs. Furthermore, this review examines how viruses, including DENV, SARS-CoV-2, HIV-1, HCV, RSV, and HSV, manipulate host RNA modification systems. Overall, this review highlights the epitranscriptome as a dynamic interface in host-virus interactions and underscores its potential as a target for antiviral therapeutic development.

papers.title: Rabeprazole exhibits broad-spectrum fusion inhibition against Nipah pseudovirus and authentic HCoV-OC43 and RSV
papers.abstract: Rabeprazole was previously defined as a small-molecule fusion inhibitor that binds the conserved hydrophobic HR1 groove of the SARS-CoV-2 spike and blocks six-helix bundle assembly. Here, we expand its antiviral spectrum and demonstrate potent activity against Nipah virus pseudotype, HCoV-229E, and RSV. Using SPR, pseudovirus neutralization, docking, and 100-ns MD simulations, we validated binding of Rabeprazole to the HR1 domains of NiV F glycoprotein and HCoV-229E spike, with a conserved fusion-inhibitory mechanism. Systematic structure-activity relationship (SAR) profiling among clinically approved PPIs revealed that Ilaprazole and Lansoprazole exhibited stronger anti-NiV potency than Rabeprazole, while Rabeprazole sulfide showed enhanced antiviral activity relative to the parent compound. Rabeprazole also inhibited live RSV and HCoV-229E infection in a dose-dependent manner. Collectively, these findings establish the HR1 groove as a druggable pan-viral target and validate benzimidazole-based PPIs as a versatile scaffold for developing orally available, broad-spectrum antivirals against phylogenetically distinct enveloped viruses that rely on class I fusion machinery.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to expand the antiviral spectrum of Rabeprazole, a known SARS-CoV-2 fusion inhibitor, to include Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) and other enveloped viruses. The research was motivated by the need for broad-spectrum antivirals against phylogenetically distinct viruses that rely on class I fusion machinery.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted using a combination of pseudovirus neutralization, molecular docking, and molecular dynamics simulations. It involved testing Rabeprazole against RSV and other related viruses, with a focus on its mechanism of action and antiviral potency.
analysis.methods: The researchers employed SPR (Surface Plasmon Resonance), pseudovirus neutralization assays, molecular docking simulations, and 100-ns MD (Molecular Dynamics) simulations to validate the binding of Rabeprazole to the HR1 domains of NiV F glycoprotein and HCoV-229E spike, and to assess its antiviral activity.
analysis.main_results: Systematic SAR (Structure-Activity Relationship) profiling among clinically approved PPIs showed that Ilaprazole and Lansoprazole had stronger anti-NiV potency than Rabeprazole, while Rabeprazole sulfide demonstrated enhanced antiviral activity compared to the parent compound. Rabeprazole also inhibited live RSV and HCoV-229E infection in a dose-dependent manner.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that Rabeprazole and its derivatives can inhibit RSV and other enveloped viruses through a conserved fusion-inhibitory mechanism, highlighting the HR1 groove as a potential druggable target for broad-spectrum antivirals.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results provide a foundation for developing orally available, broad-spectrum antivirals targeting the HR1 groove, which could be valuable for combating RSV and related viruses that cause respiratory infections.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to in vitro and pseudovirus assays, and the evidence strength is moderate due to the lack of in vivo testing and clinical trials. The findings are based on structure-activity relationships and computational models, which may not fully reflect real-world efficacy.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the antiviral potential of Rabeprazole against Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) and other enveloped viruses. The research expands on Rabeprazole's known role as a SARS-CoV-2 fusion inhibitor by demonstrating its activity against RSV and HCoV-229E. Using SPR, pseudovirus neutralization, molecular docking, and MD simulations, the study validates Rabeprazole's binding to HR1 domains and its dose-dependent inhibition of live RSV and HCoV-229E. The findings suggest that the HR1 groove is a viable target for broad-spectrum antivirals, with implications for developing new therapeutic strategies. However, the study's reliance on in vitro and computational methods limits its evidence strength, which is assessed as moderate.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在扩大雷贝拉唑(一种已知的 SARS-CoV-2 融合抑制剂)的 抗病毒药物 谱,以包括 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 和其他包膜病毒。这项研究的动机是需要广谱 抗病毒药物 来对抗依赖 I 类融合机制的系统发育独特的病毒。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究结合了假病毒中和、分子对接和分子动力学模拟进行。它涉及测试雷贝拉唑针对 RSV 和其他相关病毒的作用,重点是其作用机制和 抗病毒药物 效力。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员采用SPR(表面等离子体共振)、假病毒中和试验、分子对接模拟和100纳秒MD(分子动力学)模拟来验证雷贝拉唑与NiV F糖蛋白和HCoV-229E刺突的HR1结构域的结合,并评估其抗病毒药物活性。
elements_zh.main_results: 临床批准的 PPI 的系统 SAR(结构-活性关系)分析表明,艾普拉唑和兰索拉唑比雷贝拉唑具有更强的抗 NiV 效力,而与母体化合物相比,硫化雷贝拉唑表现出增强的 抗病毒药物 活性。雷贝拉唑还以剂量依赖性方式抑制活 RSV 和 HCoV-229E 感染。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,雷贝拉唑及其衍生物可以通过保守的融合抑制机制抑制 RSV 和其他包膜病毒,强调 HR1 沟作为广谱 抗病毒药物 的潜在药物靶点。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为开发针对 HR1 沟的口服广谱 抗病毒药物 奠定了基础,这对于对抗引起呼吸道感染的 RSV 和相关病毒可能有价值。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于体外和假病毒检测,由于缺乏体内测试和临床试验,证据强度中等。这些发现基于结构-活动关系和计算模型,可能无法完全反映现实世界的功效。

papers.abstract_zh: 雷贝拉唑此前被定义为一种小分子融合抑制剂,可结合 SARS-CoV-2 刺突的保守疏水性 HR1 凹槽并阻断六螺旋束组装。在这里,我们扩展了其 抗病毒药物 谱,并证明了其对尼帕病毒假型、HCoV-229E 和 RSV 的有效活性。使用 SPR、假病毒中和、对接和 100 ns MD 模拟,我们验证了雷贝拉唑与 NiV F 糖蛋白和 HCoV-229E 刺突的 HR1 结构域的结合,并具有保守的融合抑制机制。临床批准的 PPI 的系统构效关系 (SAR) 分析显示,艾普拉唑和兰索拉唑比雷贝拉唑表现出更强的抗 NiV 效力,而雷贝拉唑硫化物相对于母体化合物表现出增强的 抗病毒药物 活性。雷贝拉唑还以剂量依赖性方式抑制活 RSV 和 HCoV-229E 感染。总的来说,这些发现将 HR1 沟确立为可药物化的泛病毒靶标,并验证基于苯并咪唑的 PPI 作为通用支架,可用于开发口服广谱 抗病毒药物,对抗依赖于 I 类融合机制的系统发育独特的包膜病毒。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在扩大雷贝拉唑(一种已知的 SARS-CoV-2 融合抑制剂)的 抗病毒药物 谱,以包括 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 和其他包膜病毒。这项研究的动机是需要广谱 抗病毒药物 来对抗依赖 I 类融合机制的系统发育独特的病毒。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究结合了假病毒中和、分子对接和分子动力学模拟进行。它涉及测试雷贝拉唑针对 RSV 和其他相关病毒的作用,重点是其作用机制和 抗病毒药物 效力。
analysis_zh.methods: 研究人员采用SPR(表面等离子体共振)、假病毒中和试验、分子对接模拟和100纳秒MD(分子动力学)模拟来验证雷贝拉唑与NiV F糖蛋白和HCoV-229E刺突的HR1结构域的结合,并评估其抗病毒药物活性。
analysis_zh.main_results: 临床批准的 PPI 的系统 SAR(结构-活性关系)分析表明,艾普拉唑和兰索拉唑比雷贝拉唑具有更强的抗 NiV 效力,而与母体化合物相比,硫化雷贝拉唑表现出增强的 抗病毒药物 活性。雷贝拉唑还以剂量依赖性方式抑制活 RSV 和 HCoV-229E 感染。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,雷贝拉唑及其衍生物可以通过保守的融合抑制机制抑制 RSV 和其他包膜病毒,强调 HR1 沟作为广谱 抗病毒药物 的潜在药物靶点。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为开发针对 HR1 沟的口服广谱 抗病毒药物 奠定了基础,这对于对抗引起呼吸道感染的 RSV 和相关病毒可能有价值。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于体外和假病毒检测,由于缺乏体内测试和临床试验,证据强度中等。这些发现基于结构-活动关系和计算模型,可能无法完全反映现实世界的功效。

papers.title: Deadbolt Drug Discovery: Locking the Door to Class 1 Viral Entry by Small Molecules.
papers.abstract: The continued emergence of viral pathogens underscores the need for novel antiviral therapeutics with improved efficacy. Small-molecule inhibitors of viral entry are attractive antiviral agents because they block the virus at its earliest step, preventing the virus from entering host cells and causing downstream damage. Some of the viruses of greatest concern for human health, such as human immunodeficiency virus, respiratory syncytial virus, influenza virus, Ebola virus, severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2, and Lassa virus, encode Class 1 fusion proteins which mediate membrane fusion and viral entry. In this review, we highlight recent advances in the discovery and development of small-molecule entry inhibitors reported over the past five years that target viruses encoding Class 1 fusion proteins.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on the development of small-molecule inhibitors targeting Class 1 fusion proteins in respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) to prevent viral entry into host cells. The central question is whether these inhibitors can serve as effective antiviral therapeutics for RSV-related diseases.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a narrative synthesis of recent advances in small-molecule entry inhibitors targeting viruses with Class 1 fusion proteins, including RSV, over the past five years. It does not report specific databases, search dates, or meta-analysis methods.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review highlights that small-molecule inhibitors targeting Class 1 fusion proteins have shown promise in preventing viral entry, which is a critical early step in the infection process. These inhibitors are considered attractive antiviral agents due to their potential to block downstream damage.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review notes that while there is growing interest in small-molecule entry inhibitors, the evidence is still limited and heterogeneous. There is a lack of comprehensive data on their efficacy across different RSV strains and populations, and further research is needed to address these gaps.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests that future research should prioritize the development and testing of small-molecule inhibitors targeting Class 1 fusion proteins in RSV. This includes evaluating their effectiveness against RSV-A and RSV-B strains and exploring their potential for broader antiviral applications.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the potential of small-molecule inhibitors targeting Class 1 fusion proteins in respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) to prevent viral entry into host cells. It emphasizes the importance of these inhibitors in blocking the earliest stages of infection, thereby reducing downstream damage. The review highlights recent advances in this area over the past five years but also identifies gaps in the evidence, particularly regarding efficacy across different RSV strains and populations. The findings suggest that further research is needed to develop and test these inhibitors for broader antiviral applications, especially in addressing the challenges posed by RSV-A and RSV-B strains.

elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该综述建议未来的研究应优先开发和测试针对 RSV 中 1 类融合蛋白的小分子抑制剂。这包括评估它们对 RSV-A 和 RSV-B 菌株的有效性,并探索它们在更广泛的 抗病毒药物 应用中的潜力。
